verificar: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); const git=a=>cp.execFileSync('git',a,{encoding:'utf8'}); const sec=(t,h)=>{const l=t.split('\n'),i=l.indexOf(h); if(i<0) throw Error('sem '+h); let j=i+1; while(j<l.length && !l[j].startsWith('## ')) j++; return l.slice(i+1,j).filter(x=>x.trim())}; const t=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); const base=git(['merge-base','origin/main','HEAD']).trim(); const antes=sec(git(['show',base+':CHANGELOG.md']),'## Não publicado'); const v=sec(t,'## [0.5.0] - 2026-09-30'); const falta=antes.filter(x=>!x.startsWith('- **Grafo de código') && !v.includes(x)); const rms=['RM-025','RM-026','RM-031','RM-037','RM-038','RM-048','RM-049','RM-051','RM-052','RM-054'].filter(r=>!v.some(x=>x.includes('['+r+']'))); const itens=v.filter(x=>x.startsWith('- **')).length, eram=antes.filter(x=>x.startsWith('- **')).length; if(!antes.length || sec(t,'## Não publicado').length || t.split('\n').indexOf('## Não publicado')!==6 || falta.length || rms.length || itens!==eram+1 || !v.some(x=>x.includes('KG2 e KG3')) || !v.some(x=>x.includes('fatia 1'))){console.error({base,falta,rms,itens,eram}); process.exit(1)}"
